assessments.reasoning: The IBM publication archive serves the manual. The cover title and publication number identify the publisher edition. The direct PDF acquisition matches the registered complete PDF byte digest. The cover and edition notice identify the version 6.4 product. The Preface expressly scopes the text to IBM's COBOL implementation and mentions IBM language extensions. The registry identifies a specific vendor implementation and its relationship to the independently registered language. The claim is scoped to the version 6.4 product documented by the June 28, 2024 update and the vendor's own authority. The Preface also defines shorthand covering the Value Unit Edition. The claim uses the exact named version in the edition notice and preserves that boundary.

limitations: This direction links the independent COBOL language to one publisher-documented implementation. It conveys no claim of conformance to any exact COBOL standard edition, completeness, current support, or identical semantics.
